physicalNotes: Seat U1 pin 1 at F8 and U2 pin 1 at F17. Isolate the four complementary outputs.
Hold RESET_N low to preset Q0 and clear Q1, Q2, and Q3. Release reset with the clock low before stepping the ring.
The four registered outputs each feed the next D input and their own current-limited LED.
